query: CREATE TABLE runner(id UUID NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, is_connected BOOLEAN NOT NULL, last_seen TIMESTAMPTZ, workspace_id UUID NOT NULL, cloudflare_tunnel_id TEXT NOT NULL, deleted TIMESTAMPTZ, version TEXT NOT NULL, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL, actor_type ACTOR_TYPE NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS ('runner') STORED, actor_client_type ACTOR_CLIENT_TYPE NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS ('runner') STORED);
